SS61.name: 星脉鳉
SS61.form: a small slender cylindrical body, a slightly flattened head, a small upturned mouth
SS61.fins: a short rounded dorsal fin, a rounded tail fin
SS61.markings: a single luminous vein-like line running along the flank

SS62.name: 虚空鲽
SS62.form: an oval body with a subtly flattened profile, a small head, a small terminal mouth, both eyes set close together
SS62.fins: a long dorsal fin fringing the back, a rounded tail fin
SS62.markings: a sparse scatter of luminous pores across the body, a faint void patch near the tail

SS63.name: 幽蓝鳀
SS63.form: a small slender body with a slightly rounded belly, a large mouth extending past the eye, a pointed snout
SS63.fins: a short dorsal fin, a forked tail fin
SS63.markings: a single faint line of luminous pores along the flank, a thin streak behind the gill cover

SS64.name: 星屑鲱
SS64.form: an elongated slender body with a slightly rounded belly, a small head, a short snout, a terminal mouth
SS64.fins: a short dorsal fin at the middle of the back, a forked tail fin
SS64.markings: a sparse scatter of luminous points along the flank, a faint line down the middle

SS65.name: 陨砂鲈
SS65.form: an elongated laterally compressed body with faintly grainy faceted scales, a pointed head, a large oblique mouth, the lower jaw slightly protruding
SS65.fins: a dorsal fin with a deep notch, a slightly forked tail fin
SS65.markings: a sparse scatter of granular luminous dots along the flank, a faint line of pores

SS66.name: 微弱鲳
SS66.form: a deep oval laterally compressed body with crisp bevelled edges, a small blunt head, a small mouth
SS66.fins: a long dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin
SS66.markings: a sparse row of faint luminous pores along the flank

SS67.name: 暗礁鲷
SS67.form: a deep oval laterally compressed body with faintly faceted scales, a large head, a pointed snout, a small mouth
SS67.fins: a long dorsal fin with a spiny front section, a forked tail fin
SS67.markings: a faint line of luminous pores along the flank, a single spot at the base of the tail

SS68.name: 星陨鳗
SS68.form: a long slender band-like body with faint ringed segmentation, a small pointed head, a wide mouth
SS68.fins: a continuous low dorsal fin joined to the tail fin
SS68.markings: a row of evenly spaced luminous nodes along the back, a faint line along the flank

SS69.name: 陨落魟
SS69.form: a broad diamond-shaped disc with faintly faceted wing panels, a short blunt snout, a long thin trailing tail
SS69.fins: wide angular pectoral wings, a low fin fold along the tail
SS69.markings: a sparse scatter of luminous points across the wings, a faint streak trailing behind the disc

SS70.name: 虚空鲳
SS70.form: a deep oval laterally compressed body with crisp bevelled edges, a small blunt head, a small mouth
SS70.fins: a long dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin
SS70.markings: a faint void-like ring on each flank, a sparse row of luminous pores
